description: Defines data models related to chat functionality for an Android application, including messages, message content, pending tool calls, session entries, chat history, and outgoing attachments.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with an identifier, role, content list, and optional timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Stores the content of a chat message, including type, text, MIME type, filename, and base64 encoded content.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Represents a pending tool call within a chat session, including call ID, tool name, arguments, start time, and error status.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in chat session, identified by a key, with optional update time and display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Contains the history of messages in a chat session, referenced by session key and optional session ID and thinking level.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment to be sent out from chat, including type, MIME type, filename, and base64-encoded data.
